title: A look at Wyoming's Frontier Stable Token, which launched in January and currently has a market value of ~$1M, as other states explore "white labeling" the tech (David Voreacos/Bloomberg)
summary: David Voreacos / Bloomberg: A look at Wyoming's Frontier Stable Token, which launched in January and currently has a market value of ~$1M, as other states explore “white labeling” the tech — The state, home of Yellowstone and a refuge of the rich, has become the first in the US to issue its own cryptocurrency.
